topics.topic: Ordering/precedence of A16 request-refusal checks and reasons (unknown operation/schema vs token-list reread state)
questions: For a request naming an unknown operation, at which exact step is it refused, and does it use a distinct reason from schema failure?

When token-list reread is in failed state, do other early refusals (oversize request, unknown operation/schema errors) still take precedence, or must every request return the single unknown-token-style refusal regardless of content?

topics.topic: Scope and measurement of the A16 bounded text-field size limit (which fields, bytes, and implementation-code interaction)
questions: Which fields are considered "text fields" for this limit, and is size measured as UTF-8 bytes of each string value, including nested strings, or only specific top-level fields?
Is implementation code exempt from the generic text-field limit, or must it satisfy both limits (making the 1 MiB ceiling unreachable)?

topics.topic: Case-sensitivity rule for duplicate required-header detection in manifest checks
questions: At proposal/acceptance manifest checks, is duplicate required-header detection case-insensitive (`X-Id` vs `x-id`) or byte-exact?

topics.topic: Exact media-type comparison rule for file output Content-Type matching
questions: How exactly is media-type equality checked (case sensitivity, parameter handling such as `; charset=...`, whitespace normalization)?

topics.topic: Execution scheduling on resume when service_unreachable resends coexist with other ready nodes
questions: During a resume request where both (a) service_unreachable elements exist and (b) other non-waiting nodes are already ready, must the kernel resend all unreachable elements first, or may it interleave with normal A13 ready-node execution?

topics.topic: Handling of oversized non-2xx service response bodies (read/truncate/abort and recorded detail)
questions: When a 3xx/4xx/5xx response body exceeds `service_response_bytes_max`, must the kernel keep reading full body, stop at ceiling, or abort transport immediately, and what failure detail (if any) is recorded?
What exact parser is required for this string (single ASCII space only vs general whitespace/trim), and what counts as malformed?

topics.topic: Priority rule when multiple composition-time structural faults are present (which refusal reason to report)
questions: If more than one of these composition-time structural faults is present, which one must be reported as the refusal reason?

topics.topic: Whether previously granted/approved authority remains valid after service target/route changes across restart
questions: If an approval or standing grant was created before a restart, and after restart the selected instance/base URL (or manifest route details) for that binding changes while input digests stay the same, must that old authority still be usable, or must the kernel require a fresh owner decision?

topics.topic: Which authority artifact(s) must be recorded for `draft-write` EffectAttempt entries
questions: For `draft-write` sends, especially resend-after-`not_applied` where A10 requires a fresh approval, which authority must be recorded in EffectAttempt: FlowActivation, approval/grant, or both?

topics.topic: Which failure detail classification to record for pre-send instance/config problems
questions: For send-time failures tied to service instance/config (no selected instance, bad address/class policy), which detail must be recorded: always `binding_stale` under A08, or a distinct A09 pre-send check detail?
